title: Senior Data Scientist - UK Based Client
skills: Generative AI and Large Language Models
description_html:
We are on the lookout for a skilled and motivated Senior Data Scientist to join our team and accelerate the development, deployment and adoption of machine learning models within the business. The successful candidate will be a curious, innovative, and pro-active problem solver who can leverage their experience in data engineering, machine learning and GenAI to deliver novel solutions to the business.

Within our team, we value ambition and continuous learning. This role offers significant growth opportunities for driven individuals, including exposure to impactful projects, collaboration with cross-functional teams, and the chance to shape the future of data-driven decision-making within the organization.


Responsibilities

What you’ll be doing:

  • Build robust and scalable pipelines to extract, transform, and load data for analytics and machine learning workflows.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and accessibility through automated data quality checks and validation processes.
  • Translate complex business logic and strategies into actionable data science solutions.
  • Utilise a range of statistical methods and machine learning algorithms to develop predictive models and forecasting solutions that address business challenges.
  • Deploy, monitor and maintain models in production using best practices in MLOps.
  • Lead experimentation initiatives (e.g., A/B testing, pilot programs) to validate data-driven hypotheses.
  • Use Power BI or Python-based visualizations to translate analyses into clear, actional business insights that drive decision-making.
  • Identify and explore new opportunities to leverage data and software for improving products, processes, and customer experiences.
  • Collaborate within an Agile methodology, providing time/resource estimates for proposed projects and assisting in the development of colleagues’ data science skills.

This list is not exhaustive and may be added to or amended from time to time.

What we’re looking for:

  • Essential: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Essential: Minimum of 4 years of experience in a Data Science role.
  • Essential: Proficiency in Python and strong command of SQL.
  • Essential: Experience with Git for version control.
  • Essential: Proficiency in data visualization tools, preferably Power BI.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps or similar collaborative development tools.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to identify and act on opportunities for improvement.

title: Data Scientist
description_html:
We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist with at least five years of applied quantitative experience and a strong background in statistics, econometrics, or computational finance. This position focuses on complex measurement challenges within a US-based client’s advertising business and is not a generalist data science role. The successful candidate will be responsible for framing research questions, designing rigorous studies, and developing Python code to deliver actionable insights. Daily tasks include measuring the impact of advertising assets on revenue, modeling click-through and ranking dynamics, and establishing continuous evaluation frameworks for ad strategies. This role requires becoming the domain expert around whom the engineering team collaborates and confidently presenting findings to senior executives.

Key Responsibilities:
- Translate broad business questions into precise, testable research inquiries.
- Design and implement studies and experiments, selecting appropriate methods based on available data.
- Quantify the contribution of individual advertising assets to revenue through attribution and incrementality analysis.
- Develop models for click-through rates, ranking dynamics, and market pricing.
- Establish ongoing evaluation processes for advertising strategies to ensure data-driven decision-making.
- Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate research methodologies into production monitoring systems.
- Write production-quality Python and SQL code independently, ensuring reproducibility, version control, and peer review.
- Communicate complex statistical results clearly to non-technical stakeholders and defend conclusions under scrutiny.
- Serve as the domain owner for advertising measurement within the team, guiding strategy and execution.

Required Qualifications:
- Master’s or PhD degree in statistics, econometrics, applied mathematics, physics, computational finance, or a related quantitative discipline.
- Minimum of five years of hands-on quantitative experience.
- Proficiency in Python (including pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn) and SQL.
- Strong expertise in experimental design and causal inference, with a clear understanding of the limitations of each method.
- Demonstrated independent research ability, evidenced by publications, open-source contributions, competition participation, or a professional portfolio.
- Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining complex statistical concepts to non-technical leadership.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits:
- Experience in markets, trading, pricing, ad-tech, or actuarial fields is advantageous.
- Familiarity with time series analysis or Bayesian methods.
- Background in consulting or client-facing roles is a plus.

Perks and Benefits:
- Gym membership, travel, and food allowances.
- Annual professional certification support.
- Paid time off and holidays.
- Bi-annual performance reviews accompanied by bonus opportunities.

This role offers a unique opportunity to lead advanced measurement initiatives in a dynamic advertising environment, working closely with engineering and executive teams to drive evidence-based strategies.

title: Data Scientist
description_html:
NextGen Learners is a dynamic learning and technology community dedicated to empowering the next generation with practical and in-demand digital skills. The organization provides accessible learning resources, hands-on projects, workshops, and technology-driven content focused on programming, AI and machine learning, data science, web and mobile development, and essential career skills. Committed to transforming learning into real-world opportunities, NextGen Learners fosters innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth, encouraging individuals to learn today and lead tomorrow.

The Data Scientist role at NextGen Learners is a full-time, on-site position based in Islāmābād, Pakistan. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect, clean, and analyze diverse datasets that support the organization’s learning products, community programs, and strategic initiatives. Daily responsibilities include developing predictive models, conducting exploratory data analysis, and creating dashboards and visualizations to effectively communicate insights to both technical and non-technical audiences. The role also involves designing experiments, evaluating model performance, and contributing to data-driven projects that enhance the learning experience for community members. Additionally, the Data Scientist will document methodologies, adhere to best practices in reproducible research, and stay updated with the latest advancements in data science and related technologies.

Key Responsibilities

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather, clean, and analyze data supporting learning products and community initiatives.
- Build and validate predictive models to inform decision-making and improve user experiences.
- Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
- Develop clear, engaging dashboards and visualizations tailored to diverse stakeholder groups.
- Design and conduct experiments to test hypotheses and evaluate model effectiveness.
- Document analytical processes and maintain reproducible research standards.
- Stay current with emerging data science tools, techniques, and industry trends.
- Contribute to data-driven content and projects that enhance educational outcomes for the community.

Required Qualifications

- Strong expertise in data science and analytics, including model building and insight generation.
- Solid foundation in statistics and data analysis for experimental design, hypothesis testing, and result interpretation.
- Proficiency in data visualization techniques to create impactful reports and dashboards.
- Experience with programming languages commonly used in data science, such as Python or R, and familiarity with libraries like pandas, scikit-learn, or TensorFlow.
- Working knowledge of databases and query languages such as SQL.
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Excellent problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and strong communication skills to present complex findings clearly.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Experience with cloud platforms or analytics services is advantageous.
- Passion for education, learning technologies, and supporting a community of learners through data-informed initiatives is highly valued.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a forward-thinking organization that prioritizes innovation and community impact in the digital learning space.

title: Remote Data Scientist
description_html:
Turing, headquartered in San Francisco, California, is a leading research accelerator dedicated to advancing frontier AI labs and partnering with global enterprises to deploy sophisticated AI systems. The company accelerates cutting-edge research by providing high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, and access to top AI researchers skilled in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agent technologies. Additionally, Turing helps enterprises transition AI initiatives from proof of concept to proprietary intelligence, delivering reliable systems that generate measurable business impact and drive long-term profitability.

Key Responsibilities:
- Work extensively with both structured and unstructured datasets to support benchmark-driven evaluation projects focused on real-world data engineering and data science workflows.
- Design, build, and validate robust data pipelines integral to benchmarking and evaluation processes.
- Perform data processing, feature preparation, analysis, and validation to support various data science use cases.
- Develop, run, and modify Python scripts to process data and facilitate experiments in local environments.
- Assess data quality, transformations, and outputs to ensure accuracy, reproducibility, and reliability.
- Create clean, well-documented, and reusable data workflows tailored for benchmarking purposes.
- Participate in code reviews to uphold high standards of code quality, maintainability, and best practices.
- Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers to design challenging, real-world data engineering and data science tasks that enhance AI system performance.

Required Qualifications:
- Minimum of 3 years of professional experience as a Data Engineer, Data Scientist, or Software Engineer with a strong data focus.
- Proficiency in Python programming, particularly for data engineering and data science workflows.
- Proven experience in data processing, analysis, and working with model-related workflows.
- Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals and data science principles.
- Hands-on experience handling both structured and unstructured data formats.
- Ability to comprehend, navigate, and modify complex, real-world codebases effectively.
- Skilled in writing readable, reusable, maintainable, and well-documented code.
- Strong problem-solving abilities, including experience addressing algorithmic or data-intensive challenges.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits:
- Opportunity to work fully remotely, providing flexibility and work-life balance.
- Engage with cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading companies specializing in large language models (LLMs).
- Contractor engagement requiring a minimum commitment of 4 hours per day and at least 20 hours per week, with a mandatory 4-hour overlap with Pacific Standard Time (PST).
- Contract duration is initially 3 months, with the possibility of extension based on performance and project needs.
- Note that this is a contractor role without medical benefits or paid leave.

Evaluation Process:
Candidates will undergo a technical interview featuring a live coding challenge lasting approximately 60 minutes to assess their skills and suitability for the role.

title: Data Scientist
description_html:
We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist with over five years of applied quantitative experience and a strong background in statistics, econometrics, or computational finance. This role is highly specialized and focused on solving complex measurement challenges within a US-based client’s advertising business. The successful candidate will be responsible for framing research questions, designing rigorous studies, and developing Python code to deliver actionable insights. This position requires deep domain expertise in advertising measurement, with the ability to influence engineering efforts and confidently present findings to senior leadership.

Key Responsibilities

- Research Design: Translate broad business questions into precise, testable research hypotheses. Design studies and experiments tailored to the available data and business context.

- Measurement & Modelling: Quantify the contribution of individual advertising assets to revenue through attribution and incrementality analysis. Develop models to understand click-through rates, ranking dynamics, and market pricing mechanisms.

- Continuous Evaluation: Establish ongoing evaluation frameworks to ensure advertising strategies are driven by evidence rather than intuition. Collaborate with engineering teams to operationalize research methods into production monitoring systems.

- Hands-on Analysis: Write production-quality Python and SQL code independently, without reliance on analysts. Maintain reproducibility, version control, and thorough documentation of all analyses.

- Communication & Domain Ownership: Present complex statistical findings clearly to non-technical executives and defend conclusions under scrutiny. Serve as the subject matter expert for advertising measurement within the team, guiding strategy and technical direction.

Required Qualifications

- Master’s or PhD degree in statistics, econometrics, applied mathematics, physics, computational finance, or a closely related quantitative discipline.

- Minimum of five years of practical experience applying quantitative methods in a professional setting.

- Proficiency in Python (including pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn) and SQL for data analysis and modeling.

- Strong expertise in experimental design and causal inference, with a clear understanding of the limitations of various methodologies.

- Demonstrated evidence of independent research, such as published papers, open-source contributions, competition participation, or a professional portfolio.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex statistical concepts into understandable insights for non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Experience in markets, trading, pricing, advertising technology, or actuarial science is highly desirable.

- Familiarity with time series analysis or Bayesian methods.

- Background in consulting or client-facing roles, with experience delivering actionable insights in dynamic environments.

- Benefits include gym, travel, and food allowances, annual certification support, paid time off and holidays, as well as bi-annual performance reviews and bonus opportunities.

This role offers the opportunity to lead critical measurement initiatives that directly impact advertising strategy and revenue growth. If you are a highly analytical professional with a passion for rigorous research and clear communication, this position provides a challenging and rewarding environment to apply your skills.

title: Data Scientist
description_html:
The Data Scientist at Pta plays a critical role in analyzing complex data sets to reveal actionable insights that drive strategic decisions. This position requires strong expertise in machine learning, statistical analysis, and data visualization, and involves working with large volume data using tools like Python, R, and SQL. The role demands proficiency with data manipulation libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, and experience in designing interactive dashboards using Tableau and Power BI. The Data Scientist collaborates with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into data-driven solutions, improving processes and outcomes through evidence-based decision making. This is an entry-level position requiring at least one year of relevant experience, with no team management responsibilities. In this role, the Data Scientist applies advanced analytical techniques including hypothesis testing and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch to develop predictive models and neural networks. They ensure data integrity through rigorous data transformation and conduct statistical hypothesis testing to validate business assumptions. The role emphasizes continuous learning and adaptation of new data science methods and tools to keep pace with technological advancements. Effective communication of complex analysis through clear data visualizations and dashboards is vital for informing stakeholders at various levels.
Responsibilities
  • Collect, clean, and preprocess raw data from multiple sources to ensure data quality and consistency.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis using Python, R, and SQL to identify trends, patterns, and relationships.
  • Develop machine learning models to predict outcomes and improve decision-making processes.
  • Conduct statistical analysis and hypothesis testing to validate results and support strategic initiatives.
  • Build and deploy data visualization dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, and other tools to communicate insights effectively.
  • Manipulate and analyze data with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, and Statsmodels for advanced analytical calculations.
  • Design and implement deep learning models using TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch for complex data problems.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into actionable data science projects.
  • Continuously monitor and optimize the performance of models and dashboards to maintain accuracy and usability.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation on data processes, models, and methodologies to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing.
  • Stay informed about developments in data science techniques and best practices to apply innovative solutions.
  • Support data transformation processes using Power Query and DAX expressions to structure data for analysis.
  • Create comprehensive reports integrating statistical findings and visualizations to support decision making.
